semantics.capture: q takes d at each positive edge of clk when ar is low
semantics.reset: ar is interpreted as active-high asynchronous clear; q becomes zero on assertion and stays zero at clock edges while asserted
semantics.reset_release: deassertion alone does not capture d
semantics.initialization: No initialization is specified; RTL has no initial assignment and verification does not require a defined power-up value
semantics.evidence: Original: D flip flop, positive edge triggered, with an asynchronous reset ar.

verification.oracle: Directed expected values derived from D flip flop capture and asynchronous clear interpretation of original problem
verification.sampling: Check one time unit after event, after nonblocking updates
cases: asynchronous assertion with clock held low and high
reset release holds until rising edge

specification_ambiguities.issue: Reset polarity and reset value are not explicit
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Interpret ar as active-high asynchronous reset to q=0, the conventional unqualified reset behavior for this one-bit D flip flop.
